simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דּוֹדָה (H1733) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: דּוֹדָה (dôwdâh) means an aunt First listed occurrence: Exod 6 20.

definitions.full: H1733. dodah [ דֹּדָה ] noun feminine aunt — only suffix דֹּדָֽתְךָ Lev 18:14 father's brother's wife; דֹּדָתוֺ 20:20 ; Exod 6:20 father's sister [compare Num 26:59 ].
